data.name: Aiya
data.gender_notes: Aiya is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ‘Ayah’ meaning ‘sign’ or ‘miracle’ from God. Aiya can be interpreted as ‘a sign from God’, ‘a source of life’, or ‘a living miracle’. The name Aiya carries the meaning “Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aiya usually hope their child will grow to embody life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of God’s presence and guidance in life.
data.etymology: Aiya belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aiya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
